title: CueMart: a shopping assistant that remembers
note: Sessions 1 and 2 are replayed before the demo (cuemem demo demo/shop/script.json --until 2). Session 3 is played live in the UI; the replay can also run it end to end as a check. expect: each group must match (case-insensitive, any one item of the group); expect_not: none may appear; expect_level: what we hope the controller picks (reported, not enforced).

sessions.title: First visit: shoes for a first half marathon

messages.text: Hi! I'm Maya. I just signed up for my first half marathon in November, so I need proper running shoes. I wear EU 39 and I'd like to stay under $120.
Oh, and I'm vegan, so no leather or suede please.
My friend Lena wears these and I love the look. Do you have something similar?
Nice. I'll think about it, thanks!

sessions.title: Two weeks later: a promotion, a gift, a new size

messages.text: Good news: I got promoted, so my budget for running shoes can go up to $180 now.
Also, my sister Ana turns 30 on October 3rd. She loves hiking. Any gift ideas under $60?
The trekking poles are perfect, I'll get those for her.
One more thing: I've switched to EU 40 for running shoes, my feet swell on long runs.
What size running shoes do I wear now?
Can you find shoes that look like the pair I showed you in August?
How has my shoe budget changed since we first talked?

messages.note: In the UI: Memory tab → Forget a fact → the one about Ana's birthday. Forgetting removes the whole exchange it came from (what the user said and what the assistant replied), then rebuilds facts and profile.
